briefing: Noon Made Hostile. Aten Ra advances through sun throne ascent with boss gate, split lanes, and multi-phase eclipse zones while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.

missionIntro.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The path asks for order. Three Titans enter; none may mistake brightness for safety.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge as a test of The Ascension: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Aten Ra Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
